entry.title: Resolution 577 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS THE RULES OF PROCEDURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I BY ADDING A RULE RELATING TO NATIVE HAWAIIAN LAW TRAINING

Requires Council Members to complete the Office of Hawaiian Affair’s Native Hawaiian Law legal training.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 577-26, Draft 3 & GOEAC-138 - 07/08/26
